chemistry-killer-12.material: N'ime 25 °C, $\mathrm{p}K_a$ nke acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) bụ 4.7. E gwakọtara 100 mL nke 0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ na 100 mL nke 0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ ka ọ bụrụ buffer solution. Mgbe agbakwunyere 10 mL nke 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ na ya, kedu pH nke ngwọta? (Mgbanwe ọnụọgụ n'ihi mgbanwe olu adịghị emetụta ngụkọta ọnụọgụ, ma jiri $\log 2 = 0.30$. Mgbe a na-agwakọta, NaOH na-emeghachi omume kpamkpam na acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.thinking.0: Ọsọ mmeghachi omume, ụkpụrụ Le Chatelier na batrị kemịkal
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: N'ime 25 °C, $\mathrm{p}K_a$ nke acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) bụ 4.7. E gwakọtara 100 mL nke 0.20 M $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ na 100 mL nke 0.10 M $\mathrm{CH_3COONa}$ ka ọ bụrụ buffer solution. Mgbe agbakwunyere 10 mL nke 1.0 M $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ na ya, kedu pH nke ngwọta? (Mgbanwe ọnụọgụ n'ihi mgbanwe olu adịghị emetụta ngụkọta ọnụọgụ, ma jiri $\log 2 = 0.30$. Mgbe a na-agwakọta, NaOH na-emeghachi omume kpamkpam na acetic acid.)
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Mole mbụ. HA = 20 mmol, A⁻ = 10 mmol (pH mbụ = 4.7 + log 0.5 = 4.7 − 0.30 = 4.4).
Nzọụkwụ 2: NaOH 1.0 M × 10 mL = 10 mmol → n'ime $\mathrm{OH^- + HA \rightarrow A^- + H_2O}$, HA na-ebelata 10 mmol, A⁻ na-abawanye 10 mmol. HA = 10 mmol, A⁻ = 20 mmol.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ebe ha nọ n'otu ngwọta, ọnụọgụ concentration = ọnụọgụ mole = 2. pH = 4.7 + log 2 = 4.7 + 0.30 = 5.0.
Azịza: 5.0 (d). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 4.4 bụ pH tupu agbakwunye NaOH, 4.7 bụ ịtụ na HA na A⁻ ghọrọ otu n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi, 5.3 bụ ịtụ ọnụọgụ dị ka 4)

chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.hint.0: Jiri usoro Henderson–Hasselbalch $\mathrm{pH = p}K_a + \log\frac{[\mathrm{A^-}]}{[\mathrm{HA}]}$, ma buru ụzọ chọpụta ọnụọgụ mole gbanwere site na mmeghachi omume NaOH na HA ($\mathrm{OH^- + HA \rightarrow A^- + H_2O}$).
chemistry-killer-12.s.s1.hint.1: Mbụ: HA = 0.20 × 0.100 = 20 mmol, A⁻ = 0.10 × 0.100 = 10 mmol. Ịgbakwunye NaOH = 10 mmol → HA = 10 mmol, A⁻ = 20 mmol → [A⁻]/[HA] = 2.
